name: Unload probe
description: Window check fixture that declares surface.unload, shows one document region, stores its address as the tab state and reports the region state.

status.name: probeunload.location
status.description: The state of the document region: its address, whether it loads, its session history, and the tab state that the surface read at its mount.

commands.name: probeunload.load
commands.description: Opens an http address in the document region.

commands.name: probeunload.modified
commands.description: Reports the tab as modified or clean through the tab report modified.
